units.source_text: 也许是脑子太困顿了吧，些许食物入口，我就有点想呕吐。

en.t: Perhaps my head was simply too exhausted; as soon as a little food entered my mouth, I began to feel like vomiting.

units.source_text: 幸而饭后养父母都离去，只有道子留下来。

en.t: Fortunately, after the meal, my foster parents both left, and only Michiko stayed behind.

units.source_text: 我喝了一两杯酒，脸都通红了，便在佛像面前肆无忌惮地躺了下来。

en.t: After drinking a cup or two of sake, my face turned bright red, and I lay down without restraint in front of the Buddhist image.
